answer: Stop sybils with a copper zephyr island: an agent bonds one island pass. Each cycle it sets one copper vane in the pass; verifiers match the vane's zephyr-turn to the island chart, voiding a copied vane, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 islands at 17x: one vane turns once in one pass, its turn set by that zephyr, unturnable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents set once, keep rights.
